MY RECOMMENDATION

Focus for everyday recovery, with Signal’s evidence view when a case needs deeper investigation. Concierge is the warmest option; Flow offers the strongest overview for a team.

A / EVIDENCE FIRST

Signal — Follow the failure across systems.

A spatial evidence trail puts payment, enrollment, and access in one view. A decision inspector keeps the proposed next step close to its sources.

Open full size ⤢Download PNG ↓

Where it fitsBest for detailed investigations and technical operators.

Design tradeoffMore information on screen; needs careful mobile simplification.

↑ Compare all four

B / CUSTOMER FIRST

Concierge — Start with the person who needs help.

A customer conversation leads the experience. Specialists explain their findings in context, while a quiet case dossier holds the payment and access facts.

Open full size ⤢Download PNG ↓

Where it fitsBest for solo merchants and support-led recovery.

Design tradeoffLong conversations can make comparisons across cases slower.

↑ Compare all four

C / WORKFLOW FIRST

Flow — See what needs to move forward.

A recovery board separates detection, investigation, approval, and verification. A review drawer opens the evidence without losing the team's place.

Open full size ⤢Download PNG ↓

Where it fitsBest for teams managing several cases at once.

Design tradeoffBoard movement must follow evidence; it cannot authorize a repair.

↑ Compare all four

D / DECISION FIRST

Focus — One case. One considered decision.

A single review sheet presents the facts, a before-and-after preview, and explicit approval. Extra detail is available when needed.

Open full size ⤢Download PNG ↓

Where it fitsBest for fast, deliberate merchant review and a mobile adaptation.

Design tradeoffLess visibility into the whole queue during a case review.
